title: Ultimate Sweet Syrian Currants Pilaf
description: A sweet and light Syrian dish featuring currants, cooked to perfection with binchotan-charcoal, suitable for Buddhist temple gatherings
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and soak it in water for 30 minutes
Heat the binchotan-charcoal in a small burner until it starts to smoke
In a large saucepan, combine the rice, water, sugar, rose water, cardamom powder, and salt
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover the saucepan with a tight-fitting lid
Place the smoking binchotan-charcoal on top of the lid to infuse the rice with a smoky flavor
Simmer the rice for 15 minutes, or until it is cooked and fluffy
Stir in the currants and cook for an additional 2 minutes
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it cool for 5 minutes
Fluff the rice with a fork and serve hot
